I have used their teas and tinctures on an almost daily basis for years now. Kyle is a great friend of InnerVerse and has appeared on the channel more times than I can count. These products work, not in the allopathic "pharma-medicine" way, but in a terrain-support, consciousness bolstering plant-teacher sort of way.

recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

I use LotusWei Elixirs to give me an edge with psychic & energetic sensitivity, discernment, and life force coherence. In other words, LotusWei Elixirs help me be a better podcaster and Biofield Tuner. Benefits accumulate over long term use!

recMVdJjP2VZJyI2m.Body: Clive de Carle has spent decades researching high-quality natural health essentials, from magnesium and fulvic minerals to iodine, selenium, and vegan-sourced vitamin D. His supplements are formulated with a focus on bioavailability, so the body can actually absorb and use what you're taking rather than letting it pass through unused. It's a simple, no-nonsense approach to filling the nutritional gaps most modern diets leave behind.

rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Bio: Chance Garton is the host and producer of the Innerverse Podcast, where for over a decade he has investigated consciousness, mythology, symbolism, terrain health, and the psychosomatic language of the human body and mind. A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Name: Chance Garton
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Role: Host of the Innerverse Podcast, biofield tuning practitioner & researcher

recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Airships, Ley Lines, and a Disney Carousel", "body": "Mark recapped the Sonora Aero Club, a group he described as financially connected people possibly from Germany or Prussia who built airships outside mainstream trade, and he suspected they were working with lost ancient technology. He tied the story to ley lines, saying the activity clustered along certain paths, and he relayed a book's claim that Disney's California carousel once sat where stress lines crossed. Mark speculated that the spinning ride might have shaped a toroid field around the park. He also said Tesla's Wardenclyffe Tower and the Statue of Liberty sat on similar energy corridors. Chance listened and asked questions throughout."}, {"title": "Wordplay, Watchers, and the Naval Classes", "body": "Chance relayed an etymology project he admired, which he said traced puns from language to language linking seraphim, dragons, watchers, angels and sailors. He argued that the same pattern appeared in the words fairy, ogre and reptile, and that Ferris wheels echoed the seraphim wheel. Chance also played with the words naval, noble, classes and classified, saying they all pointed back to ranks of ships and society. He admitted that not every conclusion in that research might hold, but said most were hard to argue with, and he hoped to interview its author someday."}, {"title": "Comics, Spider-Man, and Superhero Origins", "body": "Chance called comics the best way to experience fiction, arguing that readers supply the motion between the frames themselves. The talk began with Spider-Man: No Way Home and moved to Mark's reading of Our Gods Wear Spandex, which Mark said traced superhero archetypes back to theosophy and nineteenth century spiritualism. The group debated whether Spider-Man or a Jedi had the better powers, and a voicemail from Gabe sided with the Jedi. Later in the show Gordy retold a Jack Kirby horror story about the Easter Island statues and credited Kirby with a mystic streak."}, {"title": "Vibe, Art, and the Flow State", "body": "Chance said the only thing a person controls is their own vibe, and he credited his own steady energy for how the world responded to him. Mark agreed that looking inward comes first when life goes wrong. Mark then showed freehand wire wrapped crystal pieces, said he began with copper wire from his father's basement, called the work a meditation, and said an artist was designing a shirt reading my family thinks I'm crazy. Chance showed a selenite wand and invited everyone to the Weaving Spiders flow state, where guests read aloud and make art together."}, {"title": "Vortexes, Lemuria, and Stone Beings", "body": "Mike Winner called in and told Mark and Chance that he believed his home in the Six Rivers forest sat on a sacred vortex holding echoes of Lemuria, and that Sasquatch used such vortexes to move between planes. Chance described his remote tuning practice and the acupuncture chart he had bought for it, and Mike suggested bringing him onto AlphaCast. Later Mark proposed that the Easter Island statues and the animal shaped boulders of New England might be beings that solidified, drawing on a book by Mark Booth. Chance linked the word navel to the idea of the placenta as a vessel."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: On Vibe Rant 21 we hung out with Mark Steeves, the intrepid creator of My Family Thinks I'm Crazy Podcast. Later in the livestream, Gordan Hamil from the Weaving Spiders and Mike Winner from Alfa Vedic called in. This was a gem!
